_scenario: Own ship on its route with SBMPC COLAV. The adversary has no route: it starts at a random position and heading, and the solver steers it
_heading_gains: Boe (master-thesis repo, test_beds/ast_test/setup.py): own kd=66 ki=0.005, passive ship kd=75 ki=0.005. Weakly damped baseline is kd=0 ki=0
_adversary_mode: "route": the adversary follows adversary_route, and the action is a heading offset from it (max_heading_offset_deg, heading_offset_sigma_deg). "free": adversary_route is not used, see free_adversary
_free_adversary: Starts at a random position and heading from the start seed: within start_radius m of the point start_route_fraction along the own ship's route, at least land_clearance m from land. Each action turns its heading by up to max_turn_deg, and p = exp(-turn^2/2 sigma^2), so going straight is the most likely. randomise_start_each_episode: every episode gets the next start seed (start_seed, start_seed+1, ...). Use it for SAC. MCTS needs it false, since its tree assumes the same start every iteration
_reward: log(p) per action, then collision_reward or -miss_distance/miss_distance_scale at the end
_swimmers: count swimmers on random paths, swimmer i with seed first_seed + i. A path only depends on its seed: the same seed always gives the same path, and it does not react to the ships or the solver. They start within start_radius m of the point route_fraction along the own ship's route. The own ship's SBMPC avoids them. A ship within 50 m of a swimmer stops (MAR-AST's collision check), which ends the episode without a found collision. count 0 turns them off
_environment: Wave, wind and current are off so that an action trace always replays to the same outcome
